channel.title: TradesStation: Blog
channel.description: Plain-English UK home improvement guides for every trade: building, lofts, kitchens, bathrooms, roofing, electrics, gardens, carpentry and decorating.

item.title: Accessible bathrooms and Disabled Facilities Grants
item.description: Adapting a bathroom for a disabled person? Level-access showers, grab rails and how Disabled Facilities Grants from your council can help pay for the work.

item.title: Artex ceilings and asbestos: what to do
item.description: Old Artex or textured ceilings can contain asbestos. What HSE advises: when to leave it, how to test it, and how to cover or remove it safely.

item.title: Bathroom refit rules: electrics, ventilation and drains
item.description: What the rules say for a bathroom refit in England: electrical special locations, extractor fan rates, drainage, and who can certify the work.

item.title: Building Regulations for extensions and loft conversions
item.description: What Building Regulations cover for extensions and loft conversions: structure, fire safety, stairs and insulation, how approval works and why it matters.

item.title: Do you need planning permission for a driveway?
item.description: New or replacement driveway? The 5 square metre rule, permeable paving, dropped kerbs and the questions to ask your driveway installer, explained for England.

item.title: Do you need planning permission for a house extension?
item.description: Permitted development rules for house extensions in England explained: rear, side and two-storey limits, prior approval for larger extensions and when to apply.

item.title: Doorstep roofers: how to spot a rogue trader
item.description: A roofer knocks and says your roof needs urgent work? The warning signs of rogue doorstep traders, your 14-day cancellation rights and who to report them to.

item.title: EICR explained: electrical safety checks for homes
item.description: What an Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR) is, what the C1, C2, C3 and FI codes mean, and the rules for landlords in England.

item.title: Fence, wall and gate height rules
item.description: How high can a fence or garden wall be without planning permission? The 1 metre and 2 metre rules, listed buildings, conservation areas and hedges explained.

item.title: Fire doors in homes: when do you need them?
item.description: When homes need fire doors: loft conversions, integral garages and flats. What FD20 and FD30 mean, self-closers, and why fitting matters as much as the door.

item.title: Flat roof types compared: felt, EPDM and GRP
item.description: Replacing a flat roof on an extension, garage or dormer? Felt, EPDM rubber and GRP fibreglass compared, with what to check and what to ask your roofer.

item.title: Fuse box upgrades and signs you need a rewire
item.description: Old fuse box or tired wiring? When to upgrade your consumer unit, warning signs your home may need a rewire, and the certificates you should get afterwards.

item.title: Garden rooms, sheds and decking: the rules
item.description: Building a garden room, shed, summerhouse or deck? Permitted development height limits, the 30cm decking rule and when Building Regulations apply.

item.title: Home EV charger installation: grants and rules
item.description: Getting a home EV charger? What the installation involves, the government grant for renters and flat owners, smart charger rules and what to ask your installer.

item.title: How to paint new plaster
item.description: Just had a room plastered? How to tell when new plaster is dry, why you need a mist coat, and common mistakes that cause peeling paint on fresh plaster.

item.title: How to plan a house extension, step by step
item.description: Planning a house extension? A step-by-step guide from first ideas to sign-off: design, planning, Building Regulations, party walls, quotes and builders.

item.title: Kitchen and bathroom refits: the order of works
item.description: Who does what, and when, in a kitchen or bathroom refit: strip-out, first fix, plastering, second fix, tiling and sign-off, explained step by step.

item.title: Kitchen layouts explained
item.description: Galley, L-shaped, U-shaped, island or peninsula? The main kitchen layouts compared, with the spaces they suit and the practical points to plan for.

item.title: Kitchen renovation rules: what needs approval?
item.description: Planning a new kitchen? Which jobs need Building Regulations approval, a registered electrician or a Gas Safe engineer, and which you can simply get on with.

item.title: Lead paint in older homes: how to decorate safely
item.description: Homes with original pre-1960s paintwork may have lead paint. When it is a risk, why you should never dry sand it, and how to decorate safely or hire help.

item.title: Loft conversions and planning permission: the rules
item.description: Does your loft conversion need planning permission? The permitted development rules for lofts in England: volume limits, dormers, windows and exceptions.

item.title: Loft conversion types explained
item.description: Rooflight, dormer, hip-to-gable or mansard? The main types of loft conversion explained, with what each involves and the homes they usually suit.

item.title: Paint finishes explained: matt, eggshell, satin and gloss
item.description: Matt, eggshell, satin or gloss? The main paint finishes explained, where each works best, and the questions to ask your decorator before work starts.

item.title: Painting the outside of your house
item.description: Planning to paint your render, walls, windows or front door? Weather, preparation, masonry paint, access and the questions to ask an exterior decorator.

item.title: Party wall notices for extensions and loft conversions
item.description: When an extension or loft conversion needs a party wall notice in England and Wales: the three notice types, notice periods, replies, surveyors and awards.

item.title: Roof repair or re-roof: when do you need approval?
item.description: Repairing or replacing your roof? When re-roofing needs Building Regulations approval in England, what the 25% and 50% limits mean and what to ask your roofer.

item.title: Skimming, replastering or dry lining: which do you need?
item.description: Cracked or uneven walls? The difference between a skim coat, a full replaster and dry lining, when each one makes sense and what to ask your plasterer.

item.title: Solid wood, engineered wood or laminate flooring?
item.description: Solid wood, engineered wood or laminate? How they differ, where each works best, including kitchens and underfloor heating, and what to ask your fitter.

item.title: Staircase rules: replacing or adding stairs
item.description: Replacing a staircase or adding one in a loft? The Approved Document K basics for homes: rise, going, pitch, headroom, handrails and balustrade gaps.

item.title: Wet room or walk-in shower?
item.description: Wet room or walk-in shower enclosure? How they differ, what waterproofing and drainage each needs, and the questions to ask your bathroom fitter.
